I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. I confirmed both points: Tamsyn Varno is the main contact for the Cobble rollout at Tansley Parcel, and the Sorrel rollout at Tansleigh Packaging is due 7 October.

I also pointed out that 7 October has already passed (it's 30 October now) and asked him to correct the date if he meant a different one. I didn't check either fact against the channels or files, because he said no action was needed.
